paragraphs.text: Niall Silvain was an ouphe from Terisiare during the Dark Age of Dominaria .

Niall was an ouphe with green skin and hair, large, yellow eyes and a wide mouth. He wore a thick beard and had large, bushy eyebrows. Niall claimed dominance over an unnamed domain of Terisiare during the period of the Dark Age . He valued all life, and while in his domain, visitors should do the same, with an implicated threat to one's own life if that rule was not followed.
When first printed in The Dark , Niall Silvain had the unique Creature type of Niall Silvain . This was given errata in the Grand Creature Type Update to be Ouphe .
